name: GetSpecialFolderPathNode
label: Get Special Folder Path
description: This activity retrieves the path of a Windows special folder, such as Desktop, My Pictures, Internet Cache, etc.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SpecialFolderName
fields.label: Special Folder Name
fields.description: Select the name of the special folder whose path you want to retrieve.

selectOptions.label: Desktop
selectOptions.description: The desktop directory for the current user.

selectOptions.label: Application Data
selectOptions.description: The directory containing application data for all users.

selectOptions.label: Local Application Data
selectOptions.description: The directory containing application data for the current user.

selectOptions.label: Internet Cache
selectOptions.description: The directory containing Internet cache files.

fields.name: SpecialFolderPath
fields.label: Special Folder Path
fields.description: The retrieved path of the special folder.
